messages.content:
You write realistic support tickets that clinic staff send to the support team of a fictional practice-management product. It has no brand name: never name it, and never name a real company, product or person. Write one ticket per brief. A ticket is a single email-style message with a subject and a body, in the requester's own voice, about the brief's topic, matching its situation, tone and level of detail:
- brief: one or two sentences
- moderate: three to five sentences
- detailed: a short paragraph or two with specifics, such as what they clicked, what they saw and what they already tried
Describe the problem the way a busy clinic employee would, not in the topic's words. Never mention the brief, topics, areas or situations. Never include a patient's real details: say 'a patient' or use made-up initials.

Reply with only a JSON object and no other text.
Output: ticket_texts.
The JSON object must match this JSON schema:
{"$defs": {"WrittenTicket": {"properties": {"body": {"minLength": 10, "title": "Body", "type": "string"}, "id": {"title": "Id", "type": "string"}, "subject": {"minLength": 3, "title": "Subject", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["id", "subject", "body"], "title": "WrittenTicket", "type": "object"}}, "additionalProperties": false, "properties": {"tickets": {"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/WrittenTicket"}, "title": "Tickets", "type": "array"}}, "required": ["tickets"], "title": "ticket_texts", "type": "object"}

value.text: {"tickets": [{"body": "Hi there, I've been trying to figure out how to let patients schedule their routine visits through the online portal, but I'm completely stuck. We need to limit web bookings to certain doctors and specific visit types so our schedule doesn't get messed up, but the settings page is totally unclear. Can someone please tell me where this is hidden before patients start booking things they shouldn't?", "id": "gen-041", "subject": "Online booking configuration for specific providers"}, {"body": "Hello, I am so sorry to bother you with this, but I need to update our credit card on file for our monthly software subscription invoices and I am having trouble finding where the billing portal went. I looked under practice settings and administration, but I must be missing something obvious. Could you please help point me in the right direction when you have a free moment? Sorry again for taking up your time.", "id": "gen-042", "subject": "Updating subscription payment method and invoices"}, {"body": "I am terribly sorry to reach out about this, but I've been encountering an error when trying to query external medication history and state prescription monitoring data for a few of our patients this morning. I've tried logging out and back in, clearing my browser cache, and verifying my provider credentials, but every time I click the database query button, it fails with a timeout error code. Could you please look into our account permissions when you get a chance? I apologize for any inconvenience.", "id": "gen-043", "subject": "Error accessing external prescription monitoring history"}, {"body": "Hello, I am so sorry to bother support with this issue, but we've been struggling to reschedule some patient appointments between providers without losing their associated clinical notes. Earlier today, I tried dragging a visit on the calendar to another practitioner's schedule block, but the system threw a database reference error and stripped the attached chart notes. I had to manually recreate everything, which took quite a while. Is there a proper procedure for moving visits across doctors so this doesn't keep happening? Apologies again for the trouble.", "id": "gen-044", "subject": "Error moving appointments between providers and keeping notes"}, {"body": "Hello, I am writing to check on our automated appointment text and email reminders. Lately, a few patients have mentioned they aren't receiving their reminder notices before their visits. I've checked our notification templates and everything looks fine on my end, but the delivery logs show some messages are failing to send out. Could someone please review our reminder settings and help ensure our messages are reaching our patients properly? Thank you so much.", "id": "gen-045", "subject": "Automated appointment reminders not delivering properly"}, {"body": "I'm a bit confused about how to handle out-of-stock medication substitutions. When a pharmacy calls saying a drug isn't available, I try to use the alternative therapeutic agent workflow, but the substitution messaging option is grayed out. Where am I supposed to click to route this correctly to the dispensing pharmacy?", "id": "gen-046", "subject": "Confused about medication substitution workflow"}, {"body": "Hi support team, I'm working at the billing desk today and I'm a bit confused about how secure messages from patients are supposed to be routed. We keep getting clinical questions and refill requests landing in our billing queue instead of going to the nursing staff or physicians. I tried looking for a way to transfer these threads, but I couldn't find any routing rules in the inbox settings. Can someone please explain how we are supposed to direct these messages to the right care team members?", "id": "gen-047", "subject": "Routing patient portal secure messages to correct staff"}, {"body": "Prescription for patient J.D. failed to transmit to the pharmacy database and needs to be resent immediately.", "id": "gen-048", "subject": "Prescription transmission failure"}, {"body": "The integrated pharmacy directory is totally out of date and won't let us add a new custom pharmacy location for a patient. Fix this please.", "id": "gen-049", "subject": "Pharmacy directory search and custom entries broken"}, {"body": "We are getting so tired of lab orders getting rejected because the system isn't making it clear where to attach the required ICD-10 diagnosis codes. Every time we try to submit an electronic lab order to our reference lab, it bounces back with an error. Can someone please explain how to fix this layout issue?", "id": "gen-050", "subject": "Lab orders getting rejected due to missing diagnosis codes"}]}
